description: Covers capturing and packaging the provenance of software and data: which inputs, code versions, parameters, environments and agents produced each result, recorded run by run; the W3C PROV model for describing it, RO-Crate for packaging research objects with their provenance, embedding provenance in file metadata, and data-flow lineage across pipelines. Use when the user asks where a result came from or whether it can be traced, wants provenance capture, lineage or an RO-Crate, or mentions PROV, research objects or audit trails; use PROACTIVELY when a pipeline produces results whose origins must be reconstructable long after the run.
